purpose: Two optional static 3D assets for the natural-ocean V0 game.

visual_review.method: Local Three.js GLTFLoader in headless Edge, screenshots visually inspected
visual_review.notes: Natural pale rock with warm peach branching coral and turquoise plates; complete static prop; Y-up, bottom at -0.43732. Some coarse faceting visible at close range; use as small or mid-distance decorative outcrop.

assets.prompt: A single small natural tropical coral reef cluster, rounded pale limestone base, warm peach and coral-orange branching staghorn corals, turquoise blue small plate corals, soft sea-green algae. Charming hand-painted stylized 3D ocean exploration game asset, organic believable forms, gentle saturated natural palette, clean readable silhouette, matt non-metallic surfaces, detailed but not photorealistic. Self-contained single isolated reef prop, no surrounding ocean, no backdrop, no text, no human objects.
